translationRepairs: From the time the Mohe clan of the Greater He received Tang's gift of drums and banners, this became the Liao national regalia.
From the time Mohe of the Dahe clan received Tang's gift of drums and banners, this became the Liao national regalia.
大賀氏摩會 is Mohe of the Dahe clan: 大賀氏 is the clan name and 摩會 the personal name. The prior English wrongly turns 摩會 into a clan and 大賀 into "Greater He".
Liao, from the time the Mohe clan of the Greater He received Tang's gift of drums and banners, took this as national paraphernalia.
Liao, from the time Mohe of the Dahe clan received Tang's gift of drums and banners, took this as national paraphernalia.
Same parsing as the idiomatic field: 摩會 is the person within 大賀氏, not a "Mohe clan of the Greater He".
Thereafter they exchanged embassies with Liang and sent missions to Tang, undaunted by the hardships of the journey.
Thereafter they exchanged envoys with Liang and sent embassies to Tang, never shrinking from the effort.
The Siku witness reads 不憚勞勩, ‘not shrinking from the toil.’ The revised sentence removes invented road travel and renders the attested text naturally.
